sections.heading: C — Identity, residency and applicant requirements
sections.markdown:
## C — Identity, residency and applicant requirements

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A21
Idaho treats a person who has never held a license in any jurisdiction as a new applicant. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A21
A person returning to Idaho after obtaining a credential elsewhere is considered a new applicant. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A21
A person surrendering another jurisdiction’s license is treated as a new applicant. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A21
An Idaho license that expired twenty-five months or more earlier puts the holder in the new-applicant category. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A21
A new credential application requires evidence of age and identity. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A21
A new credential application requires verification of a Social Security card or number. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A21
A new credential application requires evidence of Idaho residency. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A21
Where applicable, a new credential application requires lawful-presence documents. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A21
A new applicant may need visual or medical certification when it applies to the applicant. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A21
Applicants younger than seventeen must provide driver training completion evidence. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A21
Applicants younger than eighteen need a liability signer. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A21
Applicants younger than eighteen must supply school-compliance verification. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A21
The county office must verify age and identity before issuing a license or identification card. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A21
Surrendering a state photo credential together with a United States birth certificate showing the full legal name and birth date is sufficient age-and-identity evidence. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A21
The age-and-identity documents described in the handbook cannot be submitted as photocopies or faxes. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A22
A driver privilege card does not qualify as age-and-identity evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A22
An other-state license or identification card needs a United States birth certificate or equivalent to serve as identity evidence in Idaho. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A22
An applicant younger than eighteen does not have to possess a photo identification card. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A22
A minor without photo identification may use a parent’s or guardian’s photo identification with the child’s certified original birth certificate and any necessary guardianship evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A22
When a minor presents an accepted photo identification document, extra parental or guardian identification is unnecessary. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A22
A birth certificate submitted for identity proof must be accompanied by an accepted photo identity document. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A22
When a birth certificate name differs from the current name, a secondary document must connect the names. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A22
A certified marriage certificate or court name-change document can connect a birth name with the current legal name. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A22
An Idaho photo license or identification card expired less than five years is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A22
An other-state photo license or identification card expired less than five years is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A22
An acceptable valid Homeland Security photo document is listed as photo identity evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A22
Military identification, including retired or dependent military cards, appears among the accepted photo identity documents. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A22
A valid United States passport or passport card is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A23
An original citizenship or naturalization document is listed among photo identity documents. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A23
A foreign passport is listed among the accepted identity documents. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A23
An Idaho concealed-weapons permit expired no more than one year is listed among the photo identity documents. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A23
A veteran Universal Access Card carrying a photograph is listed as photo identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A23
A Native American identification card with a photograph is listed as photo identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F34 | anchor: A23
A Transportation Workers Identity Credential is listed as photo identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F35 | anchor: A23
A junior or senior high school photo card is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence, but a college or university photo card is excluded from that example. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F36 | anchor: A23
A junior high, senior high, college, university or military annual yearbook is listed among identity evidence. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F37 | anchor: A23
Photo identification from Idaho Corrections or Juvenile Corrections is listed among the accepted identity documents. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0023]

Misconceptions: A secondary identity document by itself does not establish identity; a supporting document must accompany the primary proof.
Mnemonic: Identity, address and consent is a teaching checklist for assembling the application evidence.
Glossary: Lawful presence concerns eligibility to be in the country; a liability signer accepts legal responsibility; VOC records school compliance.
Dynamic facts: dated credential access policies, local service details and fee amounts are kept as verification debt outside the knowledge blocks.
